response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with ~15+ years of experience, but their background is predominantly web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, Ember, DLang) rather than the deep, current C++ expertise this role requires. Professional C++ exposure is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments a decade ago, and there is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL practices, MQTT, industrial protocols, or Azure. While systems-level experience with low-latency DLang services shows relevant fundamentals (concurrency, async I/O, performance), the gap to the core C++/industrial-cybersecurity requirements is too large for this specific position.
strengths: Extensive senior-level engineering experience with high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems (DLang, async I/O, fibers)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools, mentoring, workshops and open-source contributions
Event-driven architecture and geo/IoT-adjacent platform experience (GISCollective, Kubernetes, message-driven design)
concerns: Minimal professional C++/STL experience — only a brief role in 2014–2015 plus a thesis project
No demonstrated Secure Development Lifecycle, IEC 62443, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No exposure to MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus, or other industrial automation protocols; recent work is web/product-focused
